description: This Java class implements the DeviceRegistrationReadPlatformService interface, providing methods to retrieve device registration data from the database. It includes query methods to fetch all device registrations, a specific registration by ID, and by client ID, utilizing JDBC template and a row mapper.

classes.name: DeviceRegistrationDataMapper
classes.description: An inner class implementing RowMapper to map ResultSet rows to DeviceRegistrationData objects. It constructs SQL schema and performs the mapping of database fields to domain objects.

methods.name: retrieveAllDeviceRegiistrations
methods.description: Fetches all device registration entries from the database, ensuring the user is authenticated.

methods.name: retrieveDeviceRegiistration
methods.description: Fetches a specific device registration by its ID, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: retrieveDeviceRegiistrationByClientId
methods.description: Fetches device registration associated with a specific client ID, throws exception if not found.
